title: Yu-Kim-Hakim-Murnaghan Extension to Even Orthogonal Groups
body_html:
Yu-Kim-Hakim-Murnaghan Extension to Even Orthogonal Groups

For \(G=O(V)\) with \(V\) even-dimensional, the datum construction still gives irreducible supercuspidal representations, these representations exhaust the supercuspidal spectrum under the same large-\(p\) hypotheses, and the same equivalence relation on data classifies isomorphism classes.
proof_html: This aggregates even-orthogonal Yu irreducibility supercuspidal_theta.even_orthogonal_yu_irreducibility, Kim exhaustion supercuspidal_theta.even_orthogonal_kim_exhaustion, and even-orthogonal data equivalence supercuspidal_theta.even_orthogonal_data_equivalence_theorem. Irreducibility checks Yu's SC1-SC3 conditions for \(O(V)\), exhaustion restricts to \(SO(V)\) and lifts Kim's connected result through the \(K_{0+}\)-multiplicity space, and equivalence is handled by Clifford theory plus the connected Hakim-Murnaghan theorem.
